By accessing or using the Services, you acknowledge and accept this Disclaimer.

  1. NOT AN EMPLOYER OR RECRUITMENT GUARANTEE

Medbiomate provides tools that may help users discover job opportunities, explore employers, prepare CVs or résumés, and organize application materials.

Unless expressly stated for a specific service, Medbiomate is not:

  • The employer offering a displayed vacancy.
  • A representative or agent of an employer.
  • A government employment service.
  • A licensing or immigration authority.
  • A guarantee of recruitment, interview, or employment.

All hiring decisions are made independently by employers or recruitment organizations.

Using Medbiomate does not guarantee:

  • An interview.
  • A job offer.
  • Employment.
  • A particular salary or benefit.
  • Visa or work-permit approval.
  • Professional licensing or credential recognition.
  • A response from an employer.
  • That a vacancy will remain available.
  1. JOB LISTING INFORMATION

Job listings displayed through Medbiomate may come from:

  • Employers.
  • Recruitment partners.
  • Publicly available sources.
  • Third-party job websites or platforms.
  • Other external information providers.

Medbiomate may organize, summarize, categorize, cache, or link to this information to help users discover opportunities.

Although we aim to provide useful and current information, we do not guarantee that any job listing is:

  • Accurate.
  • Complete.
  • Current.
  • Authentic.
  • Available.
  • Suitable for a particular user.
  • Free from errors.

Job descriptions, qualifications, salaries, benefits, locations, deadlines, and application requirements may be changed by the original employer or listing provider without notice.

Users should verify every vacancy through the employer’s official website or the original listing source before applying or making decisions.

  1. THIRD-PARTY WEBSITES AND SERVICES

Medbiomate may contain links to employer websites, recruitment platforms, email services, maps, social networks, or other external services.

These third-party services are not controlled by Medbiomate.

We are not responsible for their:

  • Availability.
  • Accuracy.
  • Content.
  • Security.
  • Privacy practices.
  • Application procedures.
  • Fees.
  • Communications.
  • Recruitment decisions.
  • Products or services.

A link or reference does not necessarily indicate that Medbiomate endorses, sponsors, partners with, or is affiliated with the third party.

When you leave Medbiomate, the third party’s own terms, disclaimer, and privacy policy apply.

  1. JOB RECOMMENDATIONS AND MATCHING SCORES

Medbiomate may display recommendations, matching percentages, suggested roles, categories, employers, or vacancies based on information such as:

  • Your desired role.
  • Qualifications.
  • Skills.
  • Experience.
  • Location.
  • Work preferences.
  • Search and profile information.

These results are estimates intended to support job discovery.

They are not an employer’s assessment and do not guarantee that:

  • You satisfy the employer’s requirements.
  • Your qualifications will be recognized.
  • You are eligible for the role.
  • You will receive an interview or offer.
  • The recommendation is the best option for you.

Users must independently review the complete requirements before applying.

  1. CV AND RÉSUMÉ BUILDER

Medbiomate may provide tools to create, import, edit, format, preview, store, and download CVs or résumés.

Templates, generated text, formatting suggestions, automated features, and previews are provided as assistance tools only.

Medbiomate does not guarantee that:

  • Generated content is complete or error-free.
  • A document will meet every employer’s requirements.
  • A document will pass an applicant-tracking system.
  • A CV will result in an interview or employment.
  • Formatting will appear identically in every program, device, or printing system.
  • User-provided information is accurate.

Users must review all names, contact information, dates, qualifications, employment history, references, and other content before downloading or submitting a CV.

Users should keep independent copies of important documents.

  1. APPLICATIONS AND COMMUNICATIONS

Medbiomate may help users prepare application materials, save reusable messages, open an email application, or redirect users to an external application page.

The user is responsible for checking:

  • The intended employer and recipient.
  • The selected CV and attachments.
  • The content of the application message.
  • The accuracy of contact details.
  • The legitimacy of the job opportunity.
  • The privacy terms of the receiving organization.

Once information is sent to an employer or third party, Medbiomate cannot control how that organization stores, processes, or deletes it.

  1. EMPLOYER VERIFICATION AND JOB SCAMS

Users must use reasonable care before sharing information, making payments, attending interviews, accepting employment, or travelling for a job.

Warning signs may include requests to:

  • Pay recruitment, interview, processing, training, or equipment fees.
  • Share passwords or one-time passwords.
  • Transfer money to a personal account.
  • Purchase gift cards or cryptocurrency.
  • Disclose unnecessary banking or identity information.
  • Communicate only through unofficial or unverifiable channels.
  • Accept a position without a reasonable recruitment process.

Medbiomate does not authorize employers or recruiters to request your Medbiomate password or OTP.

Verify the employer through official contact information before acting.

Report suspicious listings or communications to:

info@medbiomate.com

You may also report suspected fraud to the appropriate local authorities.

  1. NO PROFESSIONAL ADVICE

Content provided through Medbiomate is for general informational and career-preparation purposes.

It does not constitute:

  • Legal advice.
  • Immigration advice.
  • Medical advice.
  • Financial advice.
  • Tax advice.
  • Professional licensing advice.
  • Credential-recognition advice.
  • A binding employment assessment.

Users should consult qualified professionals or the relevant authorities regarding visas, work permits, licensing, credential recognition, employment contracts, taxes, relocation, and legal matters.

  1. LICENSING, VISA, AND ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

Healthcare and other regulated professions may require specific:

  • Education.
  • Experience.
  • Professional registration.
  • Licensing examinations.
  • Credential verification.
  • Language proficiency.
  • Background checks.
  • Health checks.
  • Visa or work authorization.

Requirements differ by profession, employer, jurisdiction, and time.

Medbiomate does not determine or guarantee a user’s eligibility. Users must confirm current requirements with the employer and relevant government, licensing, immigration, or professional authorities.

  1. EMPLOYER AND USER CONTENT

Employers, users, and third parties may provide descriptions, images, logos, documents, links, and other content.

The person or organization providing that material is responsible for its accuracy, legality, and reliability.

Medbiomate may review, restrict, or remove content where reasonably necessary, but we are not obligated to verify every item before it appears.

  1. COMPANY NAMES, LOGOS, AND TRADEMARKS

Company names, logos, product names, and trademarks displayed within job listings or employer information belong to their respective owners.

Their display is for identification and informational purposes.

Unless expressly stated, such display does not indicate endorsement, sponsorship, partnership, or affiliation with Medbiomate or Second Tales Solutions LLP.

  1. AVAILABILITY AND TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE

We aim to keep the Services available and functional, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation.

Availability and performance may be affected by:

  • Internet or network conditions.
  • Device compatibility.
  • Software updates.
  • Maintenance.
  • Security incidents.
  • Third-party service failures.
  • Server or hosting interruptions.
  • Events outside our reasonable control.

Some information may be stored temporarily on a user’s device to improve loading speed and offline availability. Cached information may not always reflect the latest version.

  1. FEES

Medbiomate does not currently charge job seekers an application access fee unless a price is clearly displayed and accepted before purchase.

Employers, recruiters, external websites, professional authorities, immigration services, or other third parties may charge fees independently.

Medbiomate is not responsible for third-party charges or transactions unless Medbiomate expressly identifies and processes the payment.

Never make a payment solely because a job listing or unsolicited message requests one. Verify the request independently.

  1. PRIVACY AND USER DATA

Our handling of personal information is described in the Medbiomate Privacy Policy:

Users should review the privacy policy before creating an account, uploading a CV, adding a photograph, saving application information, or submitting data to an employer or third party.

  1. LIMITATION OF RESPONSIBILITY

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Medbiomate and Second Tales Solutions LLP are not responsible for losses or damages arising from:

  • Reliance on job listings or recommendations.
  • Employer or recruiter conduct.
  • Fraudulent or misleading third-party communications.
  • Failure to secure an interview, visa, licence, or employment.
  • External websites or services.
  • User errors in CVs or applications.
  • Loss of documents where no independent copy was maintained.
  • Service interruptions or device incompatibility.
  • Actions taken based on general information displayed through the Services.

Nothing in this Disclaimer excludes liability or consumer rights that cannot legally be excluded.

  1. CHANGES TO THIS DISCLAIMER

We may update this Disclaimer when the Services, legal requirements, or business practices change.

The updated version will be published with a revised “Last Updated” date.

Continued use of the Services after an update means that you acknowledge the revised Disclaimer, where permitted by law.

Features may include:

• Creating, importing, editing, storing, and downloading CVs or résumés.

• A vacancy remains available.

The original employer or listing provider remains responsible for its vacancy, requirements, recruitment process, and hiring decisions.

References to third-party companies, websites, or services do not imply endorsement, sponsorship, partnership, or affiliation unless expressly stated.

Some features require a Medbiomate account.

You agree to:

• Provide accurate and current registration information.
• Keep your login credentials confidential.
• Notify us promptly if you suspect unauthorized access.
• Accept responsibility for activity performed through your account.
• Maintain only accounts that you are authorized to use.

You must not share passwords, impersonate another person, create misleading accounts, or access another user’s account without permission.

We may request reasonable verification when necessary to protect accounts and users.


6. CANDIDATE PROFILES AND PREFERENCES

You may provide profile information such as your name, contact details, location, preferred roles, departments, qualifications, experience, availability, and employment preferences.

You are responsible for ensuring that this information is accurate, lawful, and suitable for employment purposes.

Job recommendations and matching scores are estimates produced from available information. They are provided for convenience and do not represent an employer’s assessment or guarantee eligibility.


7. CV AND RÉSUMÉ BUILDER

Medbiomate may allow you to create, import, edit, preview, store, and download CVs or résumés.

You retain ownership of the information and documents you create or upload.

You grant Medbiomate limited permission to store, process, reproduce, and format that content only as necessary to provide and maintain the Services.

You are responsible for:

• Reviewing generated documents before using them.
• Confirming that dates, qualifications, and employment information are correct.
• Ensuring that you have permission to include photographs, references, and third-party information.
• Keeping copies of important documents outside the application.

Templates, automated formatting, suggestions, and generated text are assistance tools. They do not constitute legal, professional, immigration, or recruitment advice.

Medbiomate does not guarantee that a CV will be accepted by an employer, applicant-tracking system, licensing authority, or government agency.


8. USER CONTENT

“User Content” includes CVs, photographs, profile details, application messages, uploaded files, and other material that you submit.

You confirm that your User Content:

• Belongs to you or is used with appropriate permission.
• Is accurate to the best of your knowledge.
• Does not infringe intellectual-property, privacy, or other legal rights.
• Does not contain malware or harmful code.
• Is not unlawful, fraudulent, threatening, abusive, or misleading.

We may restrict or remove User Content when reasonably necessary to comply with the law, protect users, maintain security, or enforce these Terms.


9. APPLICATIONS AND COMMUNICATION WITH EMPLOYERS

Medbiomate may help you prepare an application or direct you to an employer, email service, or external application page.

Before sending an application, you are responsible for reviewing:

• The employer and vacancy.
• The CV selected for submission.
• The application message and attachments.
• The recipient and contact information.
• Any terms and privacy notices provided by the employer or external platform.

Once information is submitted to an employer or third party, its processing is governed by that organization’s practices.

Medbiomate cannot control or delete information held independently by employers or third-party platforms.

Never pay money or disclose passwords, OTPs, bank credentials, or unnecessary identity documents solely because a listing or message asks you to do so.

Report suspicious listings to info@medbiomate.com.


10. PROHIBITED CONDUCT

You must not:

• Use the Services for illegal, fraudulent, or deceptive activity.
• Submit false qualifications, licences, or employment history.
• Impersonate another person, employer, or organization.
• Scrape, harvest, or systematically extract information without written authorization.
• Circumvent access restrictions or security protections.
• Introduce viruses, malicious code, or disruptive technology.
• Interfere with the performance or availability of the Services.
• Reverse-engineer the applications except where applicable law expressly permits it.
• Send spam, unsolicited promotions, or abusive communications.
• Infringe intellectual-property, confidentiality, or privacy rights.
• Use automated systems to create accounts or overload the Services.
• Resell or commercially exploit the Services without written permission.


11. FEES AND PAID FEATURES

Access to Medbiomate is currently provided to job seekers without an application access fee unless a price is clearly displayed before purchase.

We may introduce optional paid features in the future.

Employers or external websites may provide services or request payments independently.

Medbiomate is not responsible for third-party fees unless Medbiomate expressly processes and identifies the charge.

We do not control third-party services and are not responsible for their:

• Availability or security.

“Medbiomate” and related branding may not be copied or used without permission.

Privacy Policy

Depending on the features you use, information may be stored on your device, synchronized with our systems, or transmitted to a third party at your direction.

You should review the Privacy Policy before submitting personal or sensitive information.


15. ACCOUNT DELETION

You may request deletion of your account through the account settings available in the application or by following the instructions on our public account-deletion page:

Delete Account

Some information may be retained when required by law, necessary for security or fraud prevention, or temporarily maintained in protected backups.

Deleting a Medbiomate account does not delete applications or information already submitted to employers or external platforms.

About MedBioMate

Welcome to MedBioMate, the leading job brokerage firm exclusively dedicated to healthcare jobs in the Middle East. We specialize in connecting healthcare professionals—especially GCC aspirants—with top career opportunities across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, and Bahrain.

At MedBioMate, our mission is to empower healthcare job seekers by leveraging our extensive network, deep industry expertise, and personalized approach to match them with the right employers. Our transparent recruitment process, end-to-end support, and commitment to excellence ensure that job seekers find the best-suited roles while healthcare institutions gain access to top-tier talent.

With a strong presence in the GCC healthcare job market, we provide a seamless, efficient, and rewarding job search experience. Whether you’re a doctor, nurse, pharmacist, or allied healthcare professional, MedBioMate is your trusted partner in securing the ideal job opportunity.

Start your journey with us today and take the next step toward your dream healthcare career in the GCC!

Your Dream Jobs Are Waiting

Over 1 million interactions, 50,000 success stories Make yours now.

Search Job
Apply Job Now

How It Works?

Job for anyone, anywhere

Identifying Jobs 🔍

We actively search and identify the best healthcare job opportunities across the GCC, ensuring a wide range of options for job seekers.

Checking Job Genuineness ✅

Every job listing goes through a rigorous verification process to confirm authenticity, preventing scams and ensuring only legitimate opportunities.

Publishing Jobs 📢

Once verified, we publish and promote these job opportunities on our platform, making them easily accessible for healthcare professionals.

Effective Date: 24 September 2026
Last Updated: 24 September 2026

  1. INTRODUCTION

This Privacy Policy explains how Second Tales Solutions LLP (“Medbiomate,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, stores, shares, and protects personal information when you use:

  • The Medbiomate website.
  • The Medbiomate Android application.
  • The Medbiomate iOS application.
  • Other services and features provided by Medbiomate.

These are collectively referred to as the “Services.”

Medbiomate is operated by:

Second Tales Solutions LLP
Malappuram, Kerala, India
Email: info@medbiomate.com
Website: https://www.medbiomate.com

By using the Services, you acknowledge the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

  1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT

The information we collect depends on the features you use.

2.1 ACCOUNT INFORMATION

When you register or sign in, we may collect:

  • Your name.
  • Email address.
  • Phone number.
  • Account identifiers.
  • Login and authentication information.
  • Profile photograph.
  • Account preferences.

Passwords should be processed and stored using secure authentication methods. We do not ask you to send your password or one-time password by email.

2.2 CANDIDATE PROFILE INFORMATION

When you create or update a profile, we may collect:

  • Current location.
  • Country and nationality.
  • Preferred work locations.
  • Desired job roles and departments.
  • Work-type and shift preferences.
  • Preferred travel distance.
  • Expected salary.
  • Availability.
  • Education and qualifications.
  • Skills, licences, certifications, and registrations.
  • Employment experience.
  • Languages.
  • Visa or work-authorization information.
  • Date of birth, where you choose to provide it.
  • Passport or identification information, where you choose to provide it.

Please do not provide sensitive information unless it is necessary for a feature you intentionally use.

2.3 CV AND RÉSUMÉ INFORMATION

When you use the CV or résumé features, we may process:

  • CVs and résumés you create or upload.
  • Contact and professional information contained in those documents.
  • Employment history.
  • Education and qualifications.
  • Skills, certificates, projects, references, and languages.
  • Profile photographs.
  • CV names, templates, colours, formatting, and customization settings.
  • Generated previews and downloaded documents.

Some CV information may be stored locally on your device. If account synchronization is available, selected information may also be stored on our systems.

2.4 JOB SEARCH AND APPLICATION INFORMATION

When you search for or interact with jobs, we may collect:

  • Search terms.
  • Selected categories and specialties.
  • Applied filters.
  • Saved or bookmarked jobs.
  • Jobs you view or select.
  • Job preferences.
  • Job-matching information.
  • Application messages saved in the application.
  • Information about external application links you open.

If you submit information directly to an employer or third-party recruitment platform, that organization will process the information under its own privacy policy.

2.5 DEVICE AND TECHNICAL INFORMATION

We may automatically receive limited technical information, including:

  • Device type and operating system.
  • Application version.
  • Browser type.
  • Internet Protocol address.
  • Language and regional settings.
  • Device or application identifiers.
  • Crash reports and diagnostic information.
  • Date and time of access.
  • Features used and performance information.
  • Network status.

We use this information to operate, secure, troubleshoot, and improve the Services.

2.6 CAMERA, PHOTOS, AND FILES

With your permission, Medbiomate may access your camera, photo library, or device files when you choose to:

  • Add or change a profile photograph.
  • Add a photograph to a CV.
  • Upload or import a CV or résumé.
  • Attach a document.
  • Download or save a generated document.

Access is requested only when needed for the relevant feature. You may manage these permissions through your device settings.

2.7 LOCATION INFORMATION

Medbiomate may use the location or work-location information you enter to provide relevant jobs and recommendations.

If a feature requests precise or approximate device location, we will request the required device permission before accessing it.

You may disable location permissions through your device settings, although some location-related features may then be unavailable.

2.8 COMMUNICATIONS

If you contact us, we may collect:

  • Your name and contact details.
  • The contents of your message.
  • Attachments you provide.
  • Information required to investigate and respond to your request.

2.9 INFORMATION STORED LOCALLY

To improve speed and offline availability, Medbiomate may store information locally on your device, such as:

  • Cached job listings.
  • Search categories.
  • Profile information.
  • Application preferences.
  • Saved jobs.
  • CV drafts and previews.
  • Session and application settings.

Locally stored information may remain on the device until you clear the application’s data or uninstall the application.

  1. HOW WE USE INFORMATION

We may use personal information to:

  • Create, authenticate, and maintain your account.
  • Provide and personalize the Services.
  • Create, edit, preview, store, and download CVs.
  • Display job listings.
  • Provide job searches, filters, and recommendations.
  • Calculate estimated job-matching results.
  • Save jobs and application preferences.
  • Synchronize supported account information between devices.
  • Respond to support and deletion requests.
  • Send essential account and service communications.
  • Detect fraud, abuse, security threats, and technical failures.
  • Diagnose crashes and improve performance.
  • Comply with legal obligations.
  • Establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.
  • Improve existing features and develop new ones.

We do not guarantee that automated recommendations or matching scores represent an employer’s decision.

  1. LEGAL BASES FOR PROCESSING

Where applicable data-protection law requires a legal basis, we process personal information based on one or more of the following:

  • Contract: Processing is necessary to provide the Services you request.
  • Consent: You have given permission for a specific use.
  • Legitimate interests: Processing is necessary to operate, secure, and improve the Services without overriding your rights.
  • Legal obligation: Processing is required to comply with applicable law.
  • Legal claims: Processing is necessary to establish, exercise, or defend legal rights.

You may withdraw consent where processing is based on consent. Withdrawal does not affect processing that occurred before consent was withdrawn.

  1. JOB RECOMMENDATIONS AND AUTOMATED PROCESSING

Medbiomate may use information such as your desired role, qualifications, skills, experience, preferences, and location to organize or recommend job listings.

Matching scores and recommendations are intended to assist your search. They do not produce binding employment decisions and do not guarantee eligibility, an interview, or employment.

Employers make their own independent recruitment decisions.

  1. HOW WE SHARE INFORMATION

We do not sell your personal information.

We may share information only in the circumstances described below.

6.1 AT YOUR DIRECTION

We may share information when you intentionally:

  • Send or export a CV.
  • Open an external application page.
  • Contact an employer.
  • Share a document.
  • Use a feature that clearly requests transmission to another service.

You should review the recipient before sending information.

6.2 SERVICE PROVIDERS

We may use trusted providers to support:

  • Website and application hosting.
  • Cloud storage.
  • Authentication.
  • Email delivery.
  • Technical support.
  • Security monitoring.
  • Performance and crash diagnostics.
  • Database management.
  • File generation or processing.

These providers may process information only to perform services for us and must protect it under contractual or legal obligations.

6.3 EMPLOYERS AND RECRUITMENT SERVICES

If you choose to apply for a role or contact an employer, information you select may be sent to that employer or recruitment service.

Information received by an employer or third-party platform is governed by its privacy practices, not solely by this Privacy Policy.

6.4 LEGAL AND SAFETY REQUIREMENTS

We may disclose information when reasonably necessary to:

  • Comply with law, regulation, legal process, or a lawful government request.
  • Protect users, the public, Medbiomate, or Second Tales Solutions LLP.
  • Investigate fraud, abuse, or security incidents.
  • Enforce our Terms and Conditions.
  • Establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.

6.5 BUSINESS TRANSFERS

If our business is involved in a merger, acquisition, restructuring, financing, or sale of assets, information may be transferred as part of that transaction.

Where required, we will provide notice and continue to protect information under applicable law.

  1. THIRD-PARTY JOB LISTINGS AND LINKS

Medbiomate may display job information supplied by employers, public sources, recruitment partners, or third-party websites.

The Services may contain links to websites and platforms that we do not operate.

When you leave Medbiomate or submit information to a third party:

  • The third party’s terms and privacy policy apply.
  • Medbiomate does not control its data practices.
  • You should review the third party’s privacy information before submitting personal data.

Displaying a listing or link does not necessarily mean that Medbiomate endorses or is affiliated with the provider.

  1. COOKIES AND SIMILAR TECHNOLOGIES

The Medbiomate website may use cookies, local storage, and similar technologies to:

  • Maintain sessions.
  • Remember preferences.
  • Provide security.
  • Understand website performance.
  • Improve the user experience.

You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling necessary cookies may prevent some features from functioning.

The mobile applications may use device storage and similar application technologies for sessions, preferences, caching, and performance.

  1. ADVERTISING

Medbiomate may display advertisements provided by Medbiomate or third-party advertising partners.

Advertising providers may collect or process certain information to deliver, measure, limit, and improve advertisements. Depending on the provider and the permissions or choices available to you, this information may include:

  • Device and application identifiers.
  • Advertising identifiers.
  • IP address.
  • Device type and operating system.
  • Approximate location derived from an IP address.
  • Advertisement views, clicks, and interactions.
  • Application usage and diagnostic information.
  • Language and regional settings.

Where required by applicable law, Medbiomate will request your consent before using information for personalized advertising.

If you do not consent to personalized advertising, you may still receive non-personalized or contextual advertisements.

You may be able to manage advertising preferences through:

  • The consent controls shown within Medbiomate.
  • Your Android or iOS privacy settings.
  • Your device’s advertising settings.
  • The privacy controls provided by the applicable advertising provider.

Third-party advertising providers process information according to their own privacy policies.

Medbiomate does not permit advertising partners to use CVs, résumés, passport or identification information, private application messages, account passwords, or uploaded documents for advertising purposes.

The advertising services used by Medbiomate may change. This Privacy Policy will be updated if a material change affects how personal information is used or shared.

  1. DATA STORAGE AND INTERNATIONAL TRANSFERS

Information may be processed in India and in other countries where our service providers operate.

Those countries may have data-protection laws different from the laws in your location.

Where required, we use appropriate safeguards for international transfers, such as contractual protections or other legally recognized mechanisms.

  1. DATA RETENTION

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to:

  • Provide the Services.
  • Maintain your account.
  • Complete a request or transaction.
  • Meet security and fraud-prevention needs.
  • Comply with legal obligations.
  • Resolve disputes.
  • Enforce agreements.

Account and profile information is generally retained while your account remains active.

When you request account deletion, we aim to delete or anonymize eligible information within 30 days after verification.

Information may remain in protected backups for up to 90 days before it is overwritten or permanently removed.

We may retain limited information for longer where required by law, necessary for fraud prevention, or needed to establish or defend legal claims.

Information already sent to an employer or third party is controlled by that organization and must be addressed directly with it.

  1. DATA SECURITY

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect personal information from unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.

These measures may include:

  • Access controls.
  • Secure authentication.
  • Encrypted network transmission where supported.
  • Restricted administrative access.
  • Security monitoring.
  • Software updates and vulnerability management.
  • Backup and recovery procedures.

No electronic transmission or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and securing the device used to access Medbiomate.

  1. YOUR RIGHTS AND CHOICES

Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have the right to:

  • Access personal information held about you.
  • Correct inaccurate or incomplete information.
  • Request deletion of personal information.
  • Restrict certain processing.
  • Object to certain processing.
  • Withdraw consent.
  • Request a portable copy of eligible information.
  • Lodge a complaint with an appropriate data-protection authority.

To exercise a privacy right, contact:

info@medbiomate.com

We may need to verify your identity before completing a request.

We aim to respond within the time required by applicable law, normally within 30 days where practicable.

  1. ACCOUNT DELETION

You may request deletion of your Medbiomate account:

  • Through the account settings in the application, where available; or
  • Through our public account-deletion page:

You may also contact info@medbiomate.com from your registered email address with the subject:

Medbiomate Account Deletion Request

Account deletion may remove:

  • Your account and login information.
  • Candidate profile.
  • Job preferences.
  • Saved jobs.
  • Stored CVs and résumés.
  • Stored profile photographs.
  • Saved application messages.
  • Other user-created content associated with your account.

Deletion is permanent and cannot be reversed.

Deleting your Medbiomate account does not delete information already submitted to employers or external platforms.

  1. DEVICE PERMISSIONS

Depending on the features you use, the Medbiomate application may request permission to access:

  • Camera.
  • Photos or media.
  • Files or documents.
  • Notifications.
  • Location, if a location-based feature is enabled.

Permissions are used only to provide the associated feature.

You may review or revoke permissions through your device settings. Revoking a permission may prevent the related feature from working.

  1. COMMUNICATION PREFERENCES

We may send essential communications relating to:

  • Account security.
  • Login activity.
  • Privacy or Terms updates.
  • Support requests.
  • Important service changes.

Where we send optional promotional communications, you may unsubscribe using the instructions provided in the message.

You may still receive essential service or security communications after opting out of marketing.

  1. CHILDREN’S PRIVACY

Medbiomate is intended for adults seeking employment and is not intended for children under 18.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18.

If you believe that a child has submitted personal information, contact info@medbiomate.com. We will investigate and take appropriate action, including deletion where required.

  1. REGION-SPECIFIC RIGHTS

18.1 INDIA

We process personal information in accordance with applicable Indian data-protection and information-technology laws.

Users may contact info@medbiomate.com regarding access, correction, deletion, consent, or grievances.

18.2 EUROPEAN ECONOMIC AREA AND UNITED KINGDOM

Where the GDPR or UK GDPR applies, users may have rights to access, correct, erase, restrict, object to processing, withdraw consent, and request data portability.

Users may also complain to their local data-protection authority.

18.3 CALIFORNIA AND OTHER UNITED STATES LOCATIONS

Where applicable state privacy law applies, residents may have rights to know, access, correct, or delete personal information and to receive information about sharing practices.

Medbiomate does not sell personal information.

We will not discriminate against users for exercising applicable privacy rights.

  1. CHANGES TO THIS PRIVACY POLICY

We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes to:

  • The Services.
  • Data-processing practices.
  • Security requirements.
  • Service providers.
  • Applicable laws.

The revised policy will display a new “Last Updated” date.

If a change materially affects your rights or how personal information is used, we may provide additional notice through the application, website, or registered email address.

  1. CONTACT AND PRIVACY GRIEVANCES

For privacy questions, requests, complaints, or account-deletion assistance, contact:

Second Tales Solutions LLP
Malappuram, Kerala, India
Email: info@medbiomate.com
Website: https://www.medbiomate.com

When contacting us about an account, use the email address registered with Medbiomate when possible.

Do not send your password, OTP, bank credentials, passport, national ID, or unnecessary sensitive documents by email.

Delete Your Medbiomate Account

Medbiomate is operated by Second Tales Solutions LLP.

You can request the permanent deletion of your Medbiomate account and the personal information associated with it.

How to request deletion

Send an email from your registered email address to:

info@medbiomate.com

Email subject:
Medbiomate Account Deletion Request

Please include:

  • Your registered name
  • Your registered email address

For your security, never send us your password, OTP, payment details, passport, national ID, or other sensitive identification documents.

What will be deleted

After verifying your request, we will delete information associated with your Medbiomate account, including:

  • Your account and login information
  • Candidate profile and job preferences
  • Saved jobs and bookmarks
  • CVs, résumés, profile photographs, and related files stored by Medbiomate
  • Saved application messages and other user-created content
  • Other personal information associated with your account

Data stored locally on your device may be removed by signing out, clearing the app’s storage, or uninstalling the Medbiomate application.

Information sent directly to employers or third-party recruitment websites is not controlled by Medbiomate. You may need to contact those organizations separately to request deletion.

Processing time and retention

We aim to complete verified deletion requests within 30 days.

Some information may remain in secure backups for up to 90 days before it is permanently removed. We may retain limited records when required by law, to prevent fraud, resolve disputes, or protect the security of our services.

Important

Account deletion is permanent and cannot be reversed. You will lose access to your saved jobs, profile information, CVs, and other account content.

Contact

Second Tales Solutions LLP
Malappuram, Kerala, India
Email: info@medbiomate.com
